consumption.no_meter_data_configure_it_below: No meter data: configure it below
consumption.long_range_averaged_every: Long range: each point is the average of {minutes} min.
consumption.gaps_in_the_line_are_periods: Gaps in the line are periods without readings (machine or meter off).
consumption.no_jobs_logged_yet_live_jobs: No jobs logged yet. Live jobs appear here if their Start/End GCode sends BRIDGE JOB START / BRIDGE JOB END (see the Activity page).
consumption.no_jobs_logged_yet_live_jobs_no_activity: No jobs logged yet. Live jobs appear here if their Start/End GCode sends BRIDGE JOB START / BRIDGE JOB END.
consumption.no_rate_enter_the_kwh_cost: No rate: enter the kWh cost to see how much you spend
consumption.cost_per_hour_now: Right now it costs ≈ {cost} per hour
consumption.tap_a_bar_hint: Tap a bar to see its value. The grey line is the {prev}, for comparison.
consumption.no_readings_in_the_range: No readings in the chosen range.
consumption.merged_hint: The file and the live job were the same run: it is counted once.
consumption.job_no_readings: No meter readings in that period.
consumption.job_tap_hint: Tap a job to see its details.
consumption.no_rate_ask_technician: No rate: ask a technician to enter the kWh cost.
consumption.jobs_subtitle: Energy and cost of each job, compared with each other.
consumption.job_share: {pct}% of the energy of the list
consumption.job_energy_bar: Energy of this job compared with the largest in the list
consumption.compare_basis: {n} jobs of the same mode and material used {avg} kWh on average ({min} to {max}).
consumption.compare_none: There are no other similar jobs to compare with yet.
consumption.running_pace: At this pace it costs {cost} per hour
consumption.running_no_readings: There are no meter readings for this job yet.
consumption.running_no_tariff: Set the rate in Summary to see the cost.
consumption.budget_hint: Choose how many kWh you want to use at most per month and the page warns you when you get close. It is saved in this browser only.
consumption.budget_projection_over: At this pace the month will end at {kwh} kWh, above the limit.
consumption.budget_projection_ok: At this pace the month will end at {kwh} kWh.
consumption.budget_header_over: This month's use is over the limit ({used} of {limit} kWh)
consumption.budget_header_near: This month's use is close to the limit ({used} of {limit} kWh)
consumption.empty_title: There are no meter readings yet
consumption.empty_text_tech: Without a meter there is no consumption to show. Add one in Meter: you need the ID and local key of the Tuya device.
consumption.empty_text_other: Without a meter there is no consumption to show. Ask a technician to set it up.
consumption.stale_text: Check that it is on and connected to the WiFi. What you see is the last reading that arrived.
consumption.units_hint: W is the power at this moment; kWh is the accumulated energy (power times time).
consumption.idle_hint: Idle is the level the machine drops to when it is not working (the lowest 10% of the readings in the range).

common.lead: What the machine uses: now, by period, by job and the history.

meterConfig.saved_live_readings_use_this_meter: Saved. Live readings use this meter from the next cycle (30 s).
meterConfig.the_service_restarts_it_by_itself: the service restarts it by itself
meterConfig.safety_alarm_if_this_meter_draws: Safety alarm: if this meter draws power with that heater off for the board (stuck relay or SSR), it notifies your phone and, if you tick it, cuts this meter.
meterConfig.the_ones_that_don_t_power: The ones that don't power the system are cut first, from lowest to highest order; the one that powers it, last.
meterConfig.cut_on_shutdown_shut_down_when: Cut on shutdown (Shut down, when finished, timer)
meterConfig.powers_the_system_cutting_it_shuts: Powers the system (cutting it shuts everything down: always last)
meterConfig.own_line_its_consumption_adds_to: Own line: its consumption adds to the total. Inside another: it measures part of that other one (e.g. the bed inside the main one), shown separately but not added, so it isn't counted twice.
meterConfig.name: Name
meterConfig.how_it_is_connected_and_what: How it is connected and what it does
meterConfig.changing_meters_doesn_t_lose_the: Changing meters doesn't lose the history: the new one's kWh counter is joined to the last saved value. This same device is the one used by
meterConfig.none_found_check_that_it_s: None found. Check that it's on and on the same WiFi; you can also type the IP by hand.
meterConfig.finds_the_ip_and_protocol_version: Finds the IP and protocol version. Tap one to use its data.
meterConfig.find_the_device_on_the_network: Find the device on the network
meterConfig.if_you_re_pair_the_device: If you re-pair the device in the app, Tuya changes its local key: you'll have to get it again.
meterConfig.on_the_system_ssh_run_the: On the system (SSH) run the wizard and paste them when it asks:
meterConfig.and_scan_the_qr_with_the: and scan the QR with the Smart Life / Tuya app.
meterConfig.in_the_app_you_have_to: in the app; you have to get it once with
meterConfig.get_the_id_and_local_key: Get the ID and local key
meterConfig.on_the_router_dhcp_reservation_if: on the router (DHCP reservation): if the IP changes, the meter stops being read.
meterConfig.it_must_be_on_the_same: . It must be on the same WiFi as the system. It's best to give it
meterConfig.a_smart_meter_breaker_or_plug: A smart meter, breaker or plug
meterConfig.the_meter_answers_over_wifi_and: The meter answers over WiFi and sometimes does not respond the first time: a few isolated failures are normal (it retries by itself). If the failures continue, check its IP and signal, or test it below.
meterConfig.the_one_powering_the_system_always: (the one powering the system always last)
meterConfig.no_meter_is_configured_add_one: No meter is configured. Add one to see the consumption (and so "Shut everything down" can cut the power).
meterConfig.id_field_hint: The id field of devices.json (about 20-22 characters)
meterConfig.leave_empty_to_keep_key: Leave it empty to keep the saved key
meterConfig.new_meter_sub: It is added as one more meter. The ones you already have do not change.
meterConfig.edit_meter_sub: The changes only affect this meter.
meterConfig.guide_show: Show the step by step guide

startup.title: Start-up
startup.state_na: does not apply to your machine
startup.make_tip: Copies the example to the SD card. It never overwrites a file that already exists.
startup.edit_tip: Opens the file in the DWC editor.
startup.hide_tip: Hides this row on this screen. It does not delete anything.
startup.service_tip: It has to be running: it makes the examples and answers the buttons of this plugin.
startup.row_meter_tip: It is your own hardware (a plug or meter that can be read over the network). Without a meter this page has nothing to show: set it up in the Meter section, or tap "Do not use".
startup.meter_none: no meter is set up yet (see Meter)
startup.meter_silent: there are meters but none answers (see Meter)
startup.row_reading_tip: The service reads the meter every few seconds. More than 90 s without a reading means the meter or the network does not answer.
startup.assist_tip: Walks you through what is missing, one thing at a time. You can skip what you do not need.
startup.assist_no_action: This cannot be fixed with a file from here. Read the explanation and, when you have it, tap "Check again".
startup.assist_done_ready: Everything you went through is ready.
startup.assist_done_left: {n} left to do. You can start again whenever you like.
startup.create_help_tip: Asks a few questions and builds the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.questions_intro: Answer and I will build the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.err_range: The number is outside the allowed range.
startup.err_chars: Do not use quotes, semicolons or line breaks.
startup.err_pattern: It does not have the expected format. See the help of this field.
startup.warn_moves: {n} line(s) that move the machine were commented out with ";". Check them and remove the ";" only when you are sure and the machine is free.
startup.warn_active: Lines without ";" really run when you use the button.
startup.plan_example: {file} only has the example (all commented). It is replaced by this one, and the previous text is kept in {backup}.
startup.plan_new: {file} already has your configuration and I will not overwrite it. This one will be saved apart as {target}; when you have checked it, rename it in Files > Macros.
startup.verify_ok: Done: the file exists, has active instructions and the plugin already sees it.
startup.verify_new: Saved as {file}. The plugin keeps using the previous file until you swap the names.
startup.verify_comments: {file} was saved, but all its lines are still commented, so the plugin still takes it as an example. That may be what you wanted.
startup.verify_notseen: {file} was saved, but the plugin does not see it as ready yet. Tap "Check again" in a few seconds.
startup.verify_missing: I could not read {file} back. Tap "Check again" to verify it.
startup.verify_fail: It could not be saved ({error}). Nothing was changed.
startup.plan_changed: The file changed while you were answering. Check again what is going to happen and confirm once more.
startup.modal_hint: Tap a card to set it up, or let it walk you through step by step.
startup.modal_sub: Get ready what this plugin needs from your machine
startup.row_meter_what: A power meter (a plug or meter with network reading) that you connect.
startup.row_meter_for: This page shows how much energy the machine uses.
startup.row_meter_missing: There is nothing to show. If you do not have a meter, tap "Do not use".
startup.row_reading_what: The last reading the service received from the meter.
startup.row_reading_for: It confirms that the meter and the network are answering.
startup.row_reading_missing: If more than 90 s pass without a reading, the meter or the network is not answering. Check that the meter is on and on the same network.

noMeter.title: This machine has no power meter
noMeter.text: Without a meter there is no consumption, cost or energy per job to show, so those sections are hidden. If you install a meter later, enable it here.
noMeter.admin_hint: Changing the profile needs an administrator session.
